images.prompt: Premium editorial illustration, high-end tech magazine style: an engineer at a sleek control desk facing a wall of serenely glowing, perfectly ordered status panels — every abstract indicator lit calm and bright; behind them, through a large window, the actual server room has gone completely dark, racks unlit, one unplugged cable hanging. The screens believe; the room knows. Deep dark navy (#161a45) dominant palette, soft cream (#F4EFE3) highlights, thin red (#eb2027) accent on the single dead cable path only — no green, no purple, no rainbow palettes. No readable text, letters, or numbers anywhere. Cinematic moody lighting, minimalist composition.
